description: Chapter summaries the reader shows under a chapter's title, keyed by chapter number, per language. Like section headings they are editorial aids, not translation: written from Open Word Bible's own wording, stating what the chapter is about and nothing more, so every language can say the same thing. They use no reader settings. Every summary is an AI draft until a named reviewer approves it.

1.en: The elder writes to the chosen lady and her children, urging them to live in truth and love by keeping God's command. Many deceivers deny that Jesus came in the flesh, and they must not be welcomed.
1.es: El anciano escribe a la señora escogida y a sus hijos, y los anima a vivir en la verdad y el amor guardando el mandamiento de Dios. Muchos engañadores niegan que Jesús vino en la carne, y no se los debe recibir.
1.fr: L’ancien écrit à la dame élue et à ses enfants, et les exhorte à vivre dans la vérité et l’amour en gardant le commandement de Dieu. Beaucoup de séducteurs nient que Jésus est venu dans la chair, et il ne faut pas les accueillir.
1.pt: O Presbítero escreve à senhora eleita e aos filhos dela, exortando-os a viver em verdade e amor, guardando o mandamento de Deus. Muitos enganadores negam que Jesus veio em carne, e eles não devem ser recebidos.
